name.description: Lowercase service name; must match the parent folder.

instanceRequired.description: Whether direct deployment requires --instance. Instance-scoped services are excluded from the all aggregate.

configurationModule.description: Optional service-owned module exporting configureEnv(env, context). Resolved inside the service directory.

source.description: GitOps source folder under deploy/gitops. Defaults to the service name; supports __ENV_KEY__ tokens.

overlay.description: Overlay directory selected for this service; supports __ENV_KEY__ tokens.

manifestContainer.description: Manifest storage container name; supports __ENV_KEY__ and __SERVICE__ tokens.

placeholders.description: Allow-listed staged files containing __ENV_KEY__ placeholders that cannot be expressed as structured Kustomize replacements.

modules.description: Ordered Bicep modules to deploy in single-service mode (dependencies included).

allModeModules.description: Modules to deploy in `all` mode (typically just this service's own module — dependencies were already handled by an earlier item).

buildWorkspaces.description: npm workspaces (relative to repo root) to compile before docker buildx build. Each runs `npm run build -w <ws>`. Defaults to ['packages/sdk']. Worker uses just the SDK; portal uses ['packages/sdk','packages/app/web'].

timeout.description: Timeout for Flux reconciliation and Kubernetes rollout status. Defaults to 10m.

rollout.description: Present when this service produces one Kubernetes resource that the orchestrator should wait on. __ENV_KEY__ tokens are resolved from the composed env.

pipeline.description: Override the default pipeline for this service. Defaults to deploy-manifest.defaults.pipelineByKind[kind].

path.description: Override path to the module's main.bicep (relative to repo root). Defaults to deploy/services/<Name>/bicep/main.bicep.
